summary: Diff adds a new PDF-to-Word tool page component, a reusable SEO hook to set/restore document title + meta description, and registers a new client-side route at `/tools/pdf-to-word-online-free` in `frontend/src/App.tsx`. The tool page includes client-side PDF type validation, simulated conversion progress, and a demo DOCX download generator. Page content is truncated, so presence/completeness of required sections (steps, benefits, full FAQ) cannot be fully verified from provided evidence.
